answered.question: Should MAPLE preserve zero surface-water depth during wind events (constant_depth), leaving water changes to SYRUP? Native commit chooses water callback when state.water exists even if water_coupling.enabled=False; default constant_free_surface can add depth under bed lowering.
answered.independent_work: source design, native guard tests, storage/checkpoint/backend development continues
answered.answer: Yes, preserve dry surface-water state during wind (Recommended)
answered.implementation: Require explicit native constant_depth on wind config and bed context; no silent overriding existing config, wind water transport stays disabled

answered.answer: Yes, use existing native error bounds (Recommended)
answered.implementation: Reuse existing native bounds with honest operand/term counts; no tolerance relaxation. Per-voxel/active transfers must match; no global bitwise identity claim. No automatic physical correction/rescaling.
